name: slopocop
description: Slopocop communication layer for concise, technically precise RU/EN development replies, questions and progress, enabled by default through trusted Codex hooks. Adds to existing instructions; humanizer-ru and slop-humanizer edit targeted prose separately. Use when improving agent communication, humanizing text or auditing prose. Requires POSIX and Python >=3.9 for hooks; host-neutral startup-instruction installation is also available. No per-reply editor, evaluator or runtime network downloads.
